sheets.prompt: Character design reference sheet for a science fiction exploration game: one warlord, a tall powerful monster, drawn four times side by side at the same scale on a plain cream background: front view, side view, three-quarter view, and its attack wind-up with a heavy two-handed glaive drawn back for a sweeping cut. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade backpack stands beside it for scale; the warlord is 2.5 metres tall, broad and upright. Design: human proportions and joints, a maned head like a great cat crossed with a ram, two curled horns, a heavy brow, a broad chest; smooth deep crimson skin with a dark mane, the base colour of its kind; a few plates of rough bronze armour on the shoulders and a wide belt; a long glaive. Proud and dangerous. Original design, medium detail, a strong readable silhouette. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream paper grain, evenly spaced views, fully visible bodies, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, lettering, labels, scenery, hollow knight, white mask, drapes, bandages, mummy, robes, gore.
